$comment: Logical schema; signaling is encrypted inside OM control channel.

CallSession.participants: authenticated, sorted set of joined DeviceIdentity endpoints; media-key delivery/rekey follows joined participant generation (ADR-0132/R-283)
CallSession.key_derivation: 1:1: session exporter bound to CallID and participants. Group: per-sender SFrame media keys are delivered only to joined participant DeviceIDs and rotated whenever the authenticated joined-participant-set generation changes; Room MLS epoch possession alone grants no media-key access (ADR-0132/R-283).
CallSession.key_capable_non_participants: none merely by Room membership or MLS epoch possession; a ServicePrincipal/BridgePrincipal receives media keys only when explicitly joined as a visible call participant under call policy

AdmissionRule: A call.offer from a principal without an accepted relationship is dropped (at most a MessageRequest-class missed-call notice: no ringing, ICE or TURN). Starting a group call that rings the Room needs room.start_call. Toward any peer that is not an accepted contact, Room co-members included, only relay candidates are used.
